description: Cheapest way to check a snippet before running it: one deterministic AST pass over Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, returning severity-ranked findings and a PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdict without patches or diffs. 65 rules, about 0.2 ms. Pay per call: 0.02 Base USDC or 0.00015 SOL over x402, no signup. Upgrade to scan_code for deterministic patches.

payment_tx.description: Optional x402 payment transaction proof: Base EVM tx hash (0x...) transferring USDC to 0xb295E606F38C363b476FC546c27226B5fBcAAEFA, or Solana tx signature transferring SOL/USDC.

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session voucher token (scanpay_sess_...) for 0ms instant execution.

source_code.description: Source code to screen (Python or JS/TS)

name: scan_quick
